note: Montana FWP fishing access site on the Big Hole River with designated primitive camping: 19 miles north of Dillon on I-15 to the Glen exit (milepost 85), then 6 miles south on the Frontage Road. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms the 30-ft trailer limit, the 7-day stay limit (now in booking), concrete ramp, toilet, primitive campsites, and lists only conservation licenses (no camping fee), matching the manual AWH-priced fees, left. Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: site count, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note corrected ('FWP camping fee': the page lists none) and trimmed of restated facilities, limits and FCFS.
